deficiencies.description: The rewrite uses 'since' to introduce a causal explanation, asserting that the terminology is still heard because a surgeon can tell by touch, whereas the original text used 'where' to describe the clinical situation without asserting causality.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: And you'll hear this kind of terminology even now, where a surgeon can see just by holding or touching a tumor, whether or not it's movable or immovable.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: This terminology is still heard now, since a surgeon can tell just by holding or touching a tumour whether it is movable or immovable.
deficiencies.studentHarm: The student may mistakenly conclude that the lecturer established a definite causal link explaining the continued survival of this historical terminology.
